title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature enables yantraverse to parse request bodies for JSON and URL-encoded data, allowing for more flexible and robust API handling. It will support common content types and handle edge cases such as malformed JSON. This improvement will enhance the overall usability of the framework for developers building RESTful APIs.
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can successfully parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and handle edge cases without errors.
reason: This feature is crucial for building robust and scalable APIs, and its implementation aligns with the framework's focus on stability and performance.
